_readme: The fourteen verified figures, lifted verbatim from index.html on 28 Oct 2026.
THE NUMBERS ARE FROZEN. Nothing here may be edited except `measuredBy`.
`measuredBy` is the one line that answers 'how was this measured': the
instrument, the window and the baseline. It is empty for every figure
because only Shrey knows it (NEEDS A2). An empty string renders NO reveal
at all - no control, no collapsed text, no affordance. A figure with a
method is evidence; a figure with an empty tooltip is a figure with a
broken tooltip, which is worse than a figure on its own.
Rebuild the markup after editing:  node tools/build-stats.js
The scatter is seeded from `seed` below, so the layout never reshuffles.
Changing the seed, or the order of `figures`, re-rolls every tile.
